🧊 Physical Properties of Matter物质的物理性质

Matter and its states物质与物质的状态

Push the plunger of a sealed syringe full of air and it slides in. Fill it with water and it will not budge. That one difference — how closely the particles are packed — explains every row of the states-of-matter table.推一支装满空气、封住口的针筒，活塞能推进去；装满水就推不动。就这一个差别——粒子挤得有多紧——解释了物质状态表的每一行。

Difficulty难度 ●○○
⏱ 20 min · ★ essential必会

🔑 Must know必须记住 · Matter and its states物质与物质的状态
  1. Matter = has mass + takes up space. 4 states: solid, liquid, gas, plasma.物质＝有质量＋占空间。4 种状态：固、液、气、等离子体。
  2. Solid: definite shape and volume. Liquid: indefinite shape, definite volume. Gas: both indefinite.固体：形状体积都固定。液体：形状不定、体积固定。气体：都不固定。
  3. Only gases are compressible (particles far apart).只有气体可压缩（粒子相距远）。

🖼️ Picture it看图理解 · Matter and its states物质与物质的状态
  • Matter (has mass, takes up space)物质（有质量、占空间）
    • Solid固体definite shape · definite volume · not compressible定形 · 定体积 · 不可压缩
    • Liquid液体takes container shape · definite volume · not compressible随容器变形 · 定体积 · 不可压缩
    • Gas气体no fixed shape or volume · compressible形状体积都不定 · 可压缩
    • Plasma等离子体very hot, charged gas (lightning, stars)极热的带电气体（闪电、恒星）

🧗 The hard part难点 · Matter and its states物质与物质的状态

Linking particles to the property table把粒子和性质表联系起来

Students memorise the table but cannot explain it.学生背得出表，却解释不了。

  1. Tight + fixed in place → keeps shape and volume (solid).紧密＋位置固定→保持形状和体积（固体）。
  2. Touching but sliding → flows (shape changes), volume fixed (liquid).接触但能滑动→能流动（形状变），体积固定（液体）。
  3. Far apart → fills container, compressible (gas).相距远→充满容器、可压缩（气体）。
Try试一试
Why does a liquid take the shape of its container?液体为什么会变成容器的形状？
Answer答案
Its particles are touching but can slide past one another, so it flows.它的粒子相互接触但能彼此滑动，所以能流动。

⚠️ Traps & tip陷阱与提示 · Matter and its states物质与物质的状态
  • Liquid has indefinite volume → it is the shape that changes; volume is definite.液体体积不固定 → 变的是形状，体积固定。
🟡
Your class notes list 4 common states including plasma, and say liquids are not compressible. Many textbooks list only 3 everyday states and say liquids are "nearly" incompressible. On this test: 4 states, and only gases are compressible.课堂讲义列出包括等离子体在内的 4 种常见状态，并说液体不可压缩。很多教材只列 3 种日常状态，说液体「几乎」不可压缩。考试按讲义：4 种状态，只有气体可压缩。
🎯
Picture each in a jar: keeps shape? fills the jar?想象放进罐子：保持形状吗？充满罐子吗？

🧊 Physical Properties of Matter物质的物理性质

Hardness, malleability, ductility, lustre, viscosity, diffusion, vapour硬度、可锻性、延性、光泽、黏度、扩散、蒸气

Aluminum foil, copper wire, honey, a diamond ring, the smell of perfume crossing a room — each one is a different property word on your test. Match the object to the word and the marks are yours.铝箔、铜线、蜂蜜、钻戒、香水味飘满房间——每一个都对应考试里一个不同的性质词。把东西和词对上，分就到手了。

Difficulty难度 ●●○
⏱ 30 min · ★ essential必会

🔑 Must know必须记住 · Hardness, malleability, ductility, lustre, viscosity, diffusion, vapour硬度、可锻性、延性、光泽、黏度、扩散、蒸气
  1. Malleable = sheets; ductile = wires; hardness = resists scratching; lustre = shiny vs dull.可锻性＝成片；延性＝成丝；硬度＝抗刮；光泽＝亮或暗。
  2. Viscosity = resistance to flow (honey high). Diffusion = high → low concentration to equilibrium.黏度＝抗流动（蜂蜜高）。扩散＝高→低浓度直到平衡。
  3. Vapour = gas from evaporation above 25 °C (class). Vapour pressure in kPa; water 3.2 kPa.蒸气＝高于 25 °C 汽化形成的气体（讲义）。蒸气压单位 kPa；水为 3.2 kPa。

🖼️ Picture it看图理解 · Hardness, malleability, ductility, lustre, viscosity, diffusion, vapour硬度、可锻性、延性、光泽、黏度、扩散、蒸气

Malleability vs ductility可锻性与延性

Malleability 可锻性
🔨 hammered into sheets 敲成薄片
e.g. aluminum foil 例：铝箔
vs
Ductility 延性
🧵 drawn into wire 拉成丝
e.g. copper wire 例：铜线

🧗 The hard part难点 · Hardness, malleability, ductility, lustre, viscosity, diffusion, vapour硬度、可锻性、延性、光泽、黏度、扩散、蒸气

Malleable vs ductile可锻性与延性

Both mean "shaped without breaking", so students swap them.两者都是「成形而不破」，学生常搞反。

  1. Ask: what shape comes out?问：做出来是什么形状？
  2. Flat sheet / foil / blade → malleable.平片／箔／刀身→可锻性。
  3. Long thin wire / thread → ductile.细长的丝／线→延性。
Try试一试
Gold leaf for decorating a cake: malleable or ductile?装饰蛋糕用的金箔：可锻性还是延性？
Answer答案
Malleable — it is a thin sheet.可锻性——它是薄片。

⚠️ Traps & tip陷阱与提示 · Hardness, malleability, ductility, lustre, viscosity, diffusion, vapour硬度、可锻性、延性、光泽、黏度、扩散、蒸气
  • Malleable = wire → no: malleable = sheet, ductile = wire.可锻性＝成丝 → 错：可锻性＝成片，延性＝成丝。
  • High viscosity = runny → high viscosity = thick, slow.黏度高＝稀 → 黏度高＝稠、流得慢。
🟡
Your class notes define vapour as gas formed by evaporation above room temperature (25 °C). Most textbooks define vapour as the gas of a substance that is normally a liquid or solid at room temperature, and note that evaporation happens at any temperature. On this test use the class version.课堂讲义把蒸气定义为高于室温（25 °C）时汽化形成的气体。多数教材的定义是：常温下本是液体或固体的物质所形成的气体，并指出任何温度下都会汽化。考试按讲义的说法。
🎯
Malleable → "mallet" (hammer) → sheet.malleable→mallet（锤子）→成片。

🧊 Physical Properties of Matter物质的物理性质

System vs phase体系与相

A glass of iced cola: how many phases? Count the visible parts — ice, liquid, bubbles — and you have the answer. Questions like this are quick marks once you know the counting rule.一杯加冰的可乐有几个相？数一数看得见的部分——冰、液体、气泡——答案就出来了。掌握数相的规则，这类题就是送分题。

Difficulty难度 ●●○
⏱ 25 min · ★ essential必会

🔑 Must know必须记住 · System vs phase体系与相
  1. System = what you are studying. Phase = a uniform part of the system.体系＝研究对象。相＝体系中均一的部分。
  2. Different states or layers = different phases. Gas mixtures = 1 phase. Solutions = 1 phase.不同状态或分层＝不同的相。气体混合物＝1 相。溶液＝1 相。
  3. Class T/F: looks uniform → one phase (True); boundary → more than one phase (True).讲义判断题：看起来均匀→一个相（对）；有分界→不止一个相（对）。

🖼️ Picture it看图理解 · System vs phase体系与相

Counting phases数一数有几个相

🧗 The hard part难点 · System vs phase体系与相

Counting phases with several states and layers多状态、多分层时数相

Students count substances or forget that gases merge into one phase.学生会去数物质，或忘了气体会合成一个相。

  1. All gases together → 1 phase.所有气体合起来→1 相。
  2. Each liquid layer → 1 phase each.每个液体层→各 1 相。
  3. Each different solid → 1 phase each. Add them up.每种不同的固体→各 1 相。加起来。
Try试一试
Oil, water and ice cubes in a beaker (class example).烧杯里有油、水和冰块（讲义例子）。
Answer答案
3 phases3 个相

⚠️ Traps & tip陷阱与提示 · System vs phase体系与相
  • Two gases = 2 phases → gases always mix into 1 phase.两种气体＝2 相 → 气体总是混成 1 相。
  • Salt water = 2 phases (two substances) → 1 phase.盐水＝2 相（两种物质）→ 1 相。
🟡
Your class answer key marks "If two substances look uniform throughout, they must be one phase" as True. Many textbooks would add that looking uniform is a good sign but not proof. On this test answer True.课堂答案把「两种物质看起来处处均匀，就一定是一个相」判为「对」。很多教材会补充：看起来均匀是很好的迹象，但不是证明。考试按讲义答「对」。
🎯
Count visibly different parts, not substances.数看得见的不同部分，不是数物质。

quiz.q: Which state has a definite volume but takes the shape of its container?哪种状态体积固定，但形状随容器改变？
quiz.a: Liquid液体
quiz.sol: • Liquids keep their volume but flow into the container's shape.液体保持体积，但会流成容器的形状。
quiz.goal: Recall the liquid row of the table.回忆性质表中液体那一行。
quiz.idea: Definite volume rules out gas; changing shape rules out solid.体积固定排除气体；形状会变排除固体。

quiz.q: Name the fourth common state of matter (besides solid, liquid, gas).说出物质的第四种常见状态（固、液、气之外）。
quiz.a: Plasma等离子体
quiz.sol: • The 4 common states: solid, liquid, gas, plasma.4 种常见状态：固体、液体、气体、等离子体。
quiz.goal: Recall plasma as the fourth state.记住等离子体是第四种状态。
quiz.idea: Lightning and the Sun are made of it.闪电和太阳就是它。

quiz.q: Is the light from a flashlight matter?手电筒发出的光是物质吗？
c: Yes, because you can see it是，因为看得见
Yes, because it fills the room是，因为它充满房间
No, because it has no mass and takes up no space不是，因为它没有质量、不占空间
No, because it is not a solid不是，因为它不是固体
quiz.a: No — light is energy: no mass, no volume.不是——光是能量：无质量、不占体积。
quiz.sol: • Light has no mass and does not take up space → energy, not matter.光没有质量也不占空间→是能量，不是物质。
quiz.goal: Apply the definition of matter to energy.把物质的定义用在能量上。
quiz.idea: Test both parts: mass? volume?两点都要检验：有质量吗？占体积吗？

quiz.q: In a particle picture, the particles are close together but arranged randomly, with no regular pattern. Which state?粒子示意图中，粒子挨得很近但排列杂乱、没有规则。是哪种状态？
quiz.a: Liquid液体
quiz.sol: • Close together → solid or liquid. Random arrangement → liquid.挨得近→固体或液体。排列杂乱→液体。
quiz.goal: Read a particle diagram.读懂粒子示意图。
quiz.idea: Close + regular = solid; close + random = liquid; far apart = gas.紧密＋规则＝固体；紧密＋杂乱＝液体；相距远＝气体。

quiz.q: Which state(s) are NOT compressible according to your notes?按讲义，哪些状态不可压缩？
c: Gas only只有气体
Solid and liquid固体和液体
Liquid and gas液体和气体
All three三种都是
quiz.a: Solid and liquid固体和液体
quiz.sol: • Gases are compressible; solids and liquids are not.气体可压缩；固体和液体不可压缩。
quiz.goal: Recall compressibility for each state.回忆每种状态的可压缩性。
quiz.idea: Only gas particles have room to be squeezed together.只有气体粒子之间有空间可挤。

quiz.q: A 500 mL bottle holds 300 mL of water and the rest is air. Water is poured into a 1 L jug, and the air escapes into the room. What is the new volume of the water, and what happens to the volume of the air? Explain.一个 500 mL 瓶子里有 300 mL 水，其余是空气。把水倒进 1 L 的壶里，空气散到房间中。水的体积现在是多少？空气的体积怎样变化？说明理由。
quiz.a: Water: still 300 mL (definite volume). Air: spreads out to fill the room, so its volume increases (indefinite volume).水：仍是 300 mL（体积固定）。空气：扩散充满房间，体积变大（体积不固定）。
quiz.sol:
• Liquid → definite volume → 300 mL in the jug, only the shape changes.液体→体积固定→壶里仍是 300 mL，只是形状变了。
  • Gas → indefinite volume → the air spreads through the room.气体→体积不固定→空气扩散到整个房间。
quiz.goal: Contrast definite volume (liquid) with indefinite volume (gas).对比液体的固定体积和气体的不固定体积。
quiz.idea: A liquid keeps its volume in any container; a gas spreads to fill whatever space it has.液体在任何容器里体积不变；气体会扩散充满所能到达的空间。

quiz.q: A scuba tank holds enough air to fill a whole room, yet the tank is small. A tank this size could never hold a room's worth of water. Explain both facts using the particle model.一个潜水气瓶装的空气能充满整个房间，可气瓶却很小。同样大小的瓶子绝不可能装下一房间的水。用粒子模型解释这两个事实。
quiz.a: Gas particles are far apart, so air can be compressed into the small tank and expands to fill a room when released. Water particles already touch, so water cannot be compressed — a room's worth of water keeps its large volume.气体粒子相距很远，空气能被压进小瓶，放出时又膨胀充满房间。水分子已经紧挨着，水不能被压缩——一房间的水体积还是那么大。
quiz.sol:
• Gas: lots of space between particles → squeezed into the tank.气体：粒子间空隙大→可压进气瓶。
  • Liquid: particles in close contact → definite volume, not compressible.液体：粒子紧密接触→体积固定，不可压缩。
quiz.goal: Apply compressibility to a real situation.把可压缩性用到实际情境中。
quiz.idea: Air can be squeezed because of the empty space between gas particles; water cannot.空气能被压缩是因为气体粒子之间有空隙；水不能。

quiz.q: Which property: a solid's resistance to being scratched?哪种性质：固体抵抗被刮划的能力？
quiz.a: Hardness硬度
quiz.sol: • Resistance to scratching = hardness.抗刮划＝硬度。
quiz.goal: Recall the definition of hardness.回忆硬度的定义。
quiz.idea: Scratching ↔ hardness.刮划↔硬度。

quiz.q: In what unit is vapour pressure measured?蒸气压用什么单位？
quiz.a: kPa (kilopascals)kPa（千帕）
quiz.sol: • Vapour pressure is a number measured in kPa.蒸气压是以 kPa 为单位的数值。
quiz.goal: Recall the unit of vapour pressure.回忆蒸气压的单位。
quiz.idea: Pressure → pascals; chemistry uses kilopascals.压强→帕斯卡；化学常用千帕。

quiz.q: A blacksmith hammers a hot iron bar into a flat blade without it cracking. Which property is shown?铁匠把烧红的铁条锤成扁平的刀身而不开裂。体现了哪种性质？
c: Ductility延性（可拉成丝）
Lustre光泽
Malleability可锻性
Viscosity黏度
quiz.a: Malleability可锻性
quiz.sol: • Shaped by hammering without breaking → malleability.锤打成形而不破裂→可锻性。
quiz.goal: Recognise malleability from a hammering example.从锤打的例子认出可锻性。
quiz.idea: Hammered into a flat shape → malleable.锤成扁平形状→可锻性。

quiz.q: Which has the highest viscosity at room temperature?室温下哪一种黏度最高？
c: Water水
Rubbing alcohol外用酒精
Honey蜂蜜
Apple juice苹果汁
quiz.a: Honey蜂蜜
quiz.sol: • Honey resists flow the most → highest viscosity.蜂蜜最抗拒流动→黏度最高。
quiz.goal: Apply "high viscosity = slow to flow".运用「黏度高＝流得慢」。
quiz.idea: Pick the one that pours most slowly.选倒得最慢的那个。

quiz.q: A quartz crystal sparkles like glass; a lump of chalk looks dull. Which property is being compared?石英晶体像玻璃一样闪亮；一块粉笔看起来暗淡。比较的是哪种性质？
quiz.a: Lustre (quartz glassy, chalk dull)光泽（石英为玻璃光泽，粉笔无光泽）
quiz.sol: • How much light a solid reflects = lustre. Quartz: glassy; chalk: dull.固体反光的程度＝光泽。石英：玻璃光泽；粉笔：暗淡。
quiz.goal: Recognise lustre as shiny vs dull.认出光泽就是亮或暗。
quiz.idea: Shiny vs dull = how much light the surface reflects.亮与暗＝表面反光多少。

quiz.q: Someone opens a bottle of perfume at the front of a classroom with no fans running. A few minutes later students at the back smell it. Name the process and describe the direction the perfume particles move.在没开风扇的教室前面打开一瓶香水。几分钟后，后排学生闻到了香味。说出这个过程并描述香水粒子移动的方向。
quiz.a: Diffusion: perfume particles move from high concentration (near the bottle) to low concentration (back of the room) until evenly spread.扩散：香水粒子从高浓度（瓶子附近）移向低浓度（教室后面），直到分布均匀。
quiz.sol:
• No fan, so the spreading is due to particle movement alone → diffusion.没有风扇，所以扩散完全靠粒子运动→扩散。
  • Direction: high → low concentration, toward equilibrium.方向：高浓度→低浓度，趋向平衡。
quiz.goal: Apply diffusion to an everyday situation.把扩散用于日常情境。
quiz.idea: Near the bottle = high concentration; back of the room = low.瓶子附近＝高浓度；教室后面＝低浓度。

quiz.q: Copper can be drawn into wire; water cannot. Is ductility a property of liquids? Explain.铜能被拉成丝，水不能。延性（可拉成丝）是液体的性质吗？说明理由。
quiz.a: No. Ductility is a property of solids (mostly metals). A liquid has no definite shape, so it cannot be drawn into a wire.不是。延性是固体（主要是金属）的性质。液体没有固定形状，不能被拉成丝。
quiz.sol:
• A wire is a fixed shape; liquids take the shape of their container.丝是固定的形状；液体会随容器变形。
  • So ductility applies to solids such as copper, not to water.所以延性适用于铜这样的固体，不适用于水。
quiz.goal: Connect ductility to the solid state.把延性和固态联系起来。
quiz.idea: A wire must keep its own shape — only a solid has a definite shape.丝必须保持自己的形状——只有固体形状固定。

quiz.q: An electrician needs a material for (a) long thin cables and (b) a scratch-resistant phone screen cover. Which property matters most for each, and which material from these fits: copper, glass-like sapphire, honey, baking soda?电工需要材料用于 (a) 细长的电缆，(b) 防刮的手机屏幕保护层。各自最看重哪种性质？在铜、蓝宝石玻璃、蜂蜜、小苏打中各选哪一个？
quiz.a: (a) Ductility → copper. (b) Hardness → sapphire.(a) 延性→铜。(b) 硬度→蓝宝石。
quiz.sol:
• Cable: must be drawn into thin wire → ductility → copper.电缆：要拉成细丝→延性→铜。
  • Screen: must resist scratches → hardness → sapphire (very hard).屏幕：要抗刮→硬度→蓝宝石（很硬）。
  • Honey (liquid) and baking soda (powder) cannot do either job.蜂蜜（液体）和小苏打（粉末）两样都做不了。
quiz.goal: Choose materials by property for a real job.按性质为实际用途选材料。
quiz.idea: Cable = wire → ductility. Screen = resists scratches → hardness.电缆＝丝→延性。屏幕＝抗刮→硬度。

quiz.q: Term: the part of the universe being studied.术语：正在研究的那部分宇宙。
quiz.a: System体系
quiz.sol: • The part being studied is the system.被研究的部分就是体系。
quiz.goal: Recall the definition of system.回忆体系的定义。
quiz.idea: What you focus on = the system.你关注的对象＝体系。

quiz.q: How many phases are in a sealed jar of pure nitrogen gas?一个装有纯氮气的密封罐里有几个相？
quiz.a: 1
quiz.sol: • Uniform gas, no layers → 1 phase.均一气体、无分层→1 个相。
quiz.goal: Count phases in a single-state pure system.数单一状态纯净体系的相数。
quiz.idea: One substance, one state, uniform → 1.一种物质、一种状态、均一→1。

quiz.q: How many phases? A glass of soda with ice cubes and bubbles rising through it.有几个相？一杯加了冰块、有气泡上升的汽水。
quiz.a: 3 (ice, liquid soda, gas bubbles)3（冰、液体汽水、气泡）
quiz.sol: • Ice (solid) + soda (liquid, sugar and gas dissolved = 1 phase) + bubbles (gas) = 3.冰（固）＋汽水（液，溶解的糖和气体算 1 相）＋气泡（气）＝3。
quiz.goal: Count phases across three states.数跨越三种状态的相。
quiz.idea: Solid, liquid and gas are each a phase.固、液、气各算一个相。

quiz.q: How many phases? Sugar stirred into water until it completely dissolves.有几个相？糖放进水里搅拌到完全溶解。
quiz.a: 1
quiz.sol: • Two substances but uniform throughout → 1 phase.两种物质，但处处均一→1 个相。
quiz.goal: Recognise that a solution is one phase.认出溶液是一个相。
quiz.idea: Completely dissolved → looks the same everywhere → 1 phase.完全溶解→处处一样→1 个相。

quiz.q: True or False: if a boundary can be seen between two substances, there is more than one phase.判断：如果两种物质之间能看到分界线，就不止一个相。
quiz.a: True对
quiz.sol: • A boundary means the two parts differ → different phases → True.有分界说明两部分不同→不同的相→对。
quiz.goal: Apply "boundary = different phases".运用「有分界＝不同的相」。
quiz.idea: A boundary separates two parts that are not the same.分界线把不相同的两部分分开。

quiz.q: Identify the system: a student studies how fast frost forms on the inside of a freezer door from moist air.找出体系：学生研究冰箱冷冻室门内侧由潮湿空气结霜的快慢。
quiz.a: The inside surface of the freezer door and the water vapour in the air.冷冻室门的内表面和空气中的水蒸气。
quiz.sol:
• Water vapour in the air is what changes; the cold door surface is where it happens.空气中的水蒸气是发生变化的东西；冷的门表面是发生的地方。
  • System = door's inside surface + water vapour.体系＝门的内表面＋水蒸气。
quiz.goal: Name every part involved in the process being studied.说出被研究过程涉及的每一部分。
quiz.idea: Like the class example of vapour condensing on a cold can: name both the surface and the water vapour.类似讲义中「水蒸气在冷罐外液化」：写出表面和水蒸气两者。

quiz.q: How many phases? A sealed bottle half full of liquid water, with water vapour and air in the space above.有几个相？一个密封瓶装了一半液态水，上方空间里有水蒸气和空气。
quiz.a: 2 (liquid water; one gas phase of air + water vapour)2（液态水；空气与水蒸气组成的一个气相）
quiz.sol:
• Liquid water → 1 phase.液态水→1 个相。
  • Air + water vapour mix completely → 1 gas phase. Total 2.空气＋水蒸气完全混合→1 个气相。共 2 个。
quiz.goal: Combine "gases always form one phase" with counting states.把「气体总是一个相」和数状态结合起来。
quiz.idea: Water vapour and air mix into one gas phase; the liquid is the other.水蒸气和空气混成一个气相；液体是另一个相。

quiz.q: A student shakes oil and vinegar salad dressing. Right after shaking it looks cloudy and mixed; after 10 minutes it separates into two layers. Count the phases after 10 minutes and explain whether shaking ever made it 1 phase.学生摇晃油醋沙拉汁。刚摇完看起来浑浊、混在一起；10 分钟后分成两层。数一数 10 分钟后的相数，并说明摇晃是否曾让它变成 1 个相。
quiz.a: 2 phases (oil layer and vinegar layer). Shaking never made 1 phase: the cloudy look shows oil droplets spread through the vinegar, so it was never uniform.2 个相（油层和醋层）。摇晃从未形成 1 个相：浑浊说明油滴散布在醋中，从来不是均一的。
quiz.sol:
• After 10 min: two layers with a boundary → 2 phases.10 分钟后：两层、有分界→2 个相。
  • Cloudy is not the same as uniform; the oil and vinegar stayed separate parts, just mixed into droplets.浑浊不等于均一；油和醋始终是分开的部分，只是被打成了液滴。
quiz.goal: Reason about phases in a real mixture that changes over time.对随时间变化的真实混合物进行相的推理。
quiz.idea: Shaking only breaks the oil into tiny droplets; they are still separate parts.摇晃只是把油打成小油滴；它们仍是分开的部分。

diag.q: Which describes a gas?哪一项描述的是气体？
c: Definite shape, definite volume形状固定、体积固定
Indefinite shape, definite volume形状不固定、体积固定
Definite shape, indefinite volume形状固定、体积不固定
Indefinite shape, indefinite volume形状不固定、体积不固定
why: That is a solid.这是固体。
That is a liquid — it keeps its volume.这是液体——它保持体积。
No state has this combination.没有哪种状态是这样的组合。
Correct: a gas fills any container, so neither shape nor volume is fixed.正确：气体充满任何容器，形状和体积都不固定。
diag.goal: Match a state to its shape and volume.把状态和形状、体积对应起来。
diag.idea: Gas fills the whole container.气体会充满整个容器。

diag.q: Why can a liquid flow but still keep a definite volume?液体为什么能流动，却仍保持固定体积？
c: Its particles are far apart粒子相距很远
Its particles touch but can slide past each other粒子相互接触但能彼此滑动
Its particles are locked in a fixed pattern粒子被固定在规则排列中
It has no mass它没有质量
why: Far-apart particles would make it compressible with indefinite volume — that is a gas.粒子相距远会使它可压缩、体积不固定——那是气体。
Correct: touching keeps the volume fixed; sliding lets it flow.正确：相互接触使体积固定；能滑动使它能流动。
Locked particles cannot flow — that is a solid.粒子被固定就不能流动——那是固体。
All matter, liquids included, has mass.所有物质（包括液体）都有质量。
diag.goal: Explain liquid behaviour with the particle model.用粒子模型解释液体的特性。
diag.idea: Two facts need two features: contact (volume) and sliding (flow).两个现象对应两个特征：接触（体积）和滑动（流动）。

diag.q: Tin is rolled into thin sheets for cans. Which property?锡被轧成薄片做罐头。是哪种性质？
c: Ductility延性
Malleability可锻性
Lustre光泽
Viscosity黏度
why: Ductility is about wires, not sheets.延性指成丝，不是成片。
Correct: rolled into sheets without breaking = malleable.正确：轧成薄片而不破裂＝可锻性。
Lustre is about shine, not shaping.光泽说的是光亮，不是成形。
Viscosity is for fluids flowing, not solids being shaped.黏度用于流体流动，不是固体成形。
diag.goal: Distinguish malleability from ductility.区分可锻性和延性。
diag.idea: Sheets → malleable.成片→可锻性。

diag.q: Two jars are joined by an open tube. Jar A starts with many gas particles, jar B with very few. What happens?两个罐子由一根打开的管子连通。A 罐一开始有很多气体粒子，B 罐很少。会发生什么？
c: Particles move from B to A until A is full粒子从 B 移到 A，直到 A 满了
Nothing, because gases do not move on their own什么都不会发生，气体不会自己动
Particles move from A to B until both have about the same concentration粒子从 A 移到 B，直到两边浓度大致相同
All particles move to B and A becomes empty所有粒子移到 B，A 变空
why: Reverses the direction — diffusion goes high → low.方向反了——扩散是高→低。
Gas particles are always moving; diffusion needs no push.气体粒子一直在运动；扩散不需要外力推动。
Correct: net movement high → low until equilibrium.正确：净移动从高到低，直到平衡。
Diffusion stops at balance (equilibrium), not when one side is empty.扩散在平衡时停止，而不是某一边变空。
diag.goal: Predict diffusion direction and end point.预测扩散的方向和终点。
diag.idea: High → low, and it ends at equilibrium.高→低，终点是平衡。

diag.q: How many phases are in a beaker of water with sand settled at the bottom?烧杯里有水，底部沉着沙子，共有几个相？
c: 1, because it is all in one beaker1，因为都在一个烧杯里
3, because sand has many grains3，因为沙有很多颗粒
0, because it is a mixture0，因为是混合物
why: One container is one system, not one phase.一个容器是一个体系，不是一个相。
Many grains of the same solid still count as one solid phase.同一种固体的许多颗粒仍算一个固相。
Correct: liquid water + solid sand = 2 phases (like the class calcium carbonate example).正确：液态水＋固态沙＝2 个相（与讲义中碳酸钙的例子相同）。
Every system has at least one phase.每个体系至少有一个相。
diag.goal: Count phases in a solid–liquid system.数固液体系的相数。
diag.idea: Count different states/parts, not containers or grains.数不同的状态／部分，不是数容器或颗粒。

diag.q: A balloon is filled with helium and air. How many phases does the gas inside have?气球里充了氦气和空气。里面的气体有几个相？
c: It depends on how much of each gas取决于各种气体的量
3, because air itself is several gases3，因为空气本身就有好几种气体
why: Correct: gases always mix evenly, so any gas mixture is 1 phase.正确：气体总能均匀混合，任何气体混合物都是 1 个相。
Counts substances instead of phases.数的是物质，不是相。
The amounts do not matter — gases mix completely in any proportion.用量无关——气体以任意比例都能完全混合。
Air has many gases but is still one phase.空气含多种气体，但仍是一个相。
diag.goal: Apply the rule that gas mixtures form one phase.运用「气体混合物是一个相」的规则。
diag.idea: Gas particles are far apart and move freely, so they mix completely.气体粒子相距远、自由运动，所以完全混合。
